questions.stem: A 17-year-old girl presents to a clinic in India with her parents for a routine health checkup. During the visit, she confides in the Medical Officer that she is in a consensual sexual relationship with her 19-year-old boyfriend. Aware of the recent changes in the Indian legal system, the medical officer reflects on the age of consent laws to ensure appropriate medical and legal advice is provided. As per Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013, what is the age at which a person can legally give consent for sexual activities as per this amendment?
